description.summary: This spell functions like silent image , except that minor image includes some minor sounds but not understandable speech
description.value: This spell functions like silent image , except that minor image includes some minor sounds but not understandable speech. This spell creates the visual illusion of an object, creature, or force, as visualized by you. The illusion does not create smell, texture, or temperature. You can move the image within the limits of the size of the effect.
